_rules: Every feature starts failing. Status changes ONLY via scripts/verify_feature.py after tests run.

features.title: Project setup (Python and Node), settings, dependency record
acceptance: uv sync --locked and npm ci --prefix server succeed
pyproject runtime deps pinned with ==; server/package.json has no ^ or ~ versions
migration-agent --help lists plan, signoff, dry-run, run, validate, report
settings load defaults from the example file; MIGRATION_AGENT_BATCH_SIZE overrides; bad int names the key
no key-like strings and no user or drive paths in tracked text files
every dependency is listed in docs/DEPENDENCIES.md; one trivial server test passes
features.test_command: uv run pytest tests/test_settings.py tests/test_project.py && npm test --prefix server

features.title: Source models, export reader, sample board export
acceptance: fixtures/acme_board.json loads; counts match the file
card with unknown member id loads and appears in export.warnings
card with missing name raises SourceError naming the card id
same file read twice gives equal results and the same source_hash

features.title: TypeScript server: SQLite store and Notion-like schema
acceptance: create a database with 3 properties and read the schema back
unknown property type rejected with the list of valid types
relation property must name an existing database
pages and people have external_id unique per database
store.ts starts with a plain-English comment block

features.title: TypeScript MCP tools with idempotent upsert
acceptance: in-memory transport lists exactly the 7 tools
missing required property and wrong value type return isError naming the property
two upserts with the same external id give count 1, results created then updated
relation to an unknown external id returns isError naming the id
built server answers one count_pages call over stdio as a child process

features.title: Python target client, FakeTarget, shared contract tests
acceptance: the same contract tests pass on FakeTarget and on McpTarget (temp SQLite)
isError result raises TargetError with the server message
missing server command error names the setting target_server
McpTarget tests skip with a clear message if server/dist is not built

features.title: Model client on LiteLLM, socket guard, scripted fake model
acceptance: chat() passes model, api_base, key from env and timeout to litellm.completion (patched)
missing key env var error names the variable and prints no other env values
timeout and HTTP errors become ModelTimeout and ModelError
socket guard blocks non-loopback connects; importing the model module passes under it
FakeModel replays a JSON script, records requests, raises ScriptExhausted at the end
default pytest run executes 0 live tests

features.title: Mapping plan with confidence and questions, human sign-off
acceptance: valid scripted reply writes plan.json with source_hash equal to the export hash
bad field name triggers one repair call, then succeeds; two bad replies raise PlanError, no file written
confidence below 0.7 creates a question
prompt holds at most 3 sample values per field
signoff refuses with unanswered questions; writes signoff.json with the plan hash
run guard refuses a missing or mismatched signoff; dry-run needs none

features.title: Transform and dry run
acceptance: transform maps source records to target records using the plan (pure functions)
dry run makes 0 write calls on FakeTarget
output lists the unknown-member warning and a preview of the first mapped card
required target property with no source fails with a message naming it

features.title: Resumable idempotent batches with checkpoint
acceptance: 120 cards with batch size 50 give 3 batches and a target count of 120
failure on batch 2 stops the run; rerun finishes with 120 and no duplicates
finished checkpoint: rerun does nothing and exits 0
checkpoint with a different plan hash is refused
crash after target write but before checkpoint write, then rerun, gives no duplicates
checkpoint is always valid JSON (temp file then rename)

features.title: Validation: counts, required fields, relations, content sample
acceptance: clean migration: all four checks pass
deleted page fails the count check naming entity and difference
changed title fails the content check naming record and field
removed relation fails the relation check naming the page id
same seed gives the same sample

features.title: Customer-facing migration report
acceptance: report.md has Summary, What moved, What changed, What did not move, Checks, Next steps
--no-llm report is complete and makes no model call
a number in the model reply that is not in the data files is dropped
a failed check shows as FAIL with ids
every number in the report appears in validation.json, checkpoint.json or plan.json

features.title: CLI, offline demo, six lessons, TypeScript walkthrough
acceptance: migration-agent demo exits 0 offline and writes plan, signoff, checkpoint, validation, report
each command prints a one-line error and exits 1 on a known error (no traceback)
lessons 01-06 run with --fake, exit 0, print one expected line
lessons/07_mcp_in_typescript.md exists; each lesson starts with a What you will learn comment
every .py under src and .ts under server/src starts with a comment block; public functions have docstrings
features.test_command: uv run pytest tests/test_cli.py tests/test_lessons.py tests/test_comments.py
